title: Document the home page feature (section fronts, Reference grids, threads) on p.apyr.us
description:
Closing task of the `homePage` epic (every Papyrus feature epic ends with a p.apyr.us docs task). The feature is named "home page" (Ryan 2026-10-31); settings key `homePage`.

## Pages (p.apyr.us repo, `AnthusAI/p.apyr.us`, content under the "Newsroom How-To" section unless the site's AGENTS.md says otherwise; merges freely per Ryan 2026-10-25)
1. "Show your newsroom's curation on the public site": what visitors see (accepted References, recommended ones, threads mixed with Stories), the Anth.us example (https://anth.us/newsroom/), the privacy rules (no person identity; which fields are public), the agent-readable twin and llms.txt.
2. "Configure the home page in projection.json": the full settings reference (`homePage` block, `pages[].source` layout with `::include{kind="references"}` / `kind="threads"` attributes and the three selections, page-level de-duplication rule, `homePage.layout: sections`, `urls.sections.<name>.index`), with the Anth.us `newsroom.md` as the worked example; `backend.plugins: ["home-page"]` and what it deploys (stream, trigger, schedule, optional interval and purge); `papyrus home-page snapshot` CLI.
3. "Section index pages and a home of sections": settings and screenshots from p.apyr.us itself (adopt `homePage.layout: sections` on p.apyr.us in the same PR if Ryan agrees; otherwise from the fixture).
4. A note in the hosting page: on CMS-style edges `/newsroom*`, `/_next/*`, `/api/*` belong to the CMS; pick another segment; Anth.us is the pure-S3 exception.

## Papyrus repo docs
- `docs/home-page.md` complete: data files and fields, task, trigger, CLI, troubleshooting (snapshot never ran -> empty grids; reconcile and `_data/home-page/`).
- `docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md`: cross-link.
- `README.md` feature list: one line.

## Acceptance
Pages live on p.apyr.us (read.p.apyr.us) with Markdown twins; links checked; wording rules (never "Draft": say "Proposed Story"; "Account", never "Organization"; attribution "AI"). Depends on: all other tasks in the epic.

comments.text: Status 2026-10-31: three How-To items exist UNPUBLISHED in the p.apyr.us CMS: howto-show-curation-on-the-public-site, howto-configure-home-page, howto-section-fronts. They describe freshness, which is released (5.64.0) but not yet enabled on Anth.us, so they stay unpublished until the Anth.us follow-up task turns it on; that task's last step publishes them (papyrus ops content publish). Stays open until then.
